description: This Java source file defines the EntityClause class used for constructing query clauses involving entities and fields within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityClause
classes.description: Represents a clause involving one or two entities and their fields, used for building query conditions.

methods.name: EntityClause
methods.description: Default constructor for EntityClause.

methods.name: EntityClause
methods.description: Constructor initializing EntityClause with two entities and their fields, along with operations.

methods.name: EntityClause
methods.description: Constructor initializing EntityClause with one entity, a field, and a value, along with operations.

methods.name: getFirstEntity
methods.description: Returns the name of the first entity involved in the clause.

methods.name: getSecondEntity
methods.description: Returns the name of the second entity involved in the clause.

methods.name: getFirstField
methods.description: Returns the name of the first field involved.

methods.name: getSecondField
methods.description: Returns the name of the second field involved.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the clause, initializing it if null.

methods.name: getIntraFieldOperation

methods.description: Sets the second field name.

methods.name: setInterFieldOperation
methods.description: Sets the operation between fields.

methods.name: setIntraFieldOperation
methods.description: Sets the intra-field operation.

methods.name: setModelEntities
